references.text: Moses placed Aaron's staff before the Lord's testimony, where it was kept. This is the same staff that Moses now takes from the Lord's presence.
The Lord commanded Moses to take the staff, and here Moses carries out this command by taking the staff from the Lord's presence.
Moses took God's staff in his hand, the same staff that was used to perform signs and wonders in Egypt.
At Massah and Meribah, Moses used the staff to strike the rock so that water came out, a similar situation to this one at Kadesh.
Aaron's staff, which budded and bore almonds, was kept before the testimony as a sign. This is the background for why the staff was placed before the Lord.
